snippet.title: Montabi - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Montabi is available now on PC, Xbox, and Nintendo Switch!

Montabi is a creature collector roguelike deckbuilder where positioning is key. Assemble an unstoppable team of unique Montabi, synergize their strategic strengths, and save the city in tactical turn-based combat!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3141630?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=organic

Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/montabi-switch-2/

Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/montabi/9PMP77PLHTX0
